newsitem.title: USA: Fine Air says files with SEC for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Fine Air says files with SEC for IPO.

text.p: Fine Air Services Inc said Friday it filed a registration statement for an initial public offering (IPO) of its common stock with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The managing underwriters for the air cargo offering are Alex. Brown Inc, Bear Stearns Cos Inc and Dillon, Read & Co Inc, the company said in a statement. It added it had not yet determined the number of shares to be offered and the range of the IPO price per share. Company officials were unavailable for comment.
